name: support_triage
provenance: AI-authored demonstration cases, written for this example; not customer data or an independent benchmark.

policy.billing: Existing payments, invoices, refunds, subscriptions, or billing records.
policy.technical_support: Product defects, errors, integrations, performance, or installation.
policy.account_security: Login credentials, identity verification, account access, or suspicious sign-ins.
policy.sales: Prospective purchases, demos, enterprise quotes, or commercial contract terms.
policy.scope: English, single-issue support requests. Use the primary requested action; mixed issues and unfamiliar requests need human judgment.
